notes: Source engine, rcon over TCP via the sidecar. The vanilla surface plus what the mods add. Every entry below was exercised against a live srcds 2.2.4.3 (build 9309) on the shipping modded image, 2026-08-30. TWO CONSTRAINTS THAT ARE NOT ERRORS, and they are different from each other: (1) All4Dead2's director commands run through FakeClientCommand, so they need A CLIENT PRESENT — on an empty server they throw `Client index 0 is invalid` and log a stack trace; with anyone connected, a bot included, they work. (2) a4d_spawn_item and a4d_spawn_weapon are a HARDER case and are absent here on purpose: they route through the `give` console command, which hard-refuses a console caller however many players are connected (S2). sm_rd_give exists because of that. THE COOP CAP IS NO LONGER AT STOCK: as of 2026-09-10 this service runs 8 human players. It is set from GAME_ENV_MAX_PLAYERS at container start (respawn-init.sh writes sv_maxplayers and sv_visiblemaxplayers into a cfg server.cfg execs), NOT by anything in this manifest — so setting sv_maxplayers here changes the running server and is reverted by the next restart, and a map change does not revert it because server.cfg re-execs. sv_maxplayers -1 restores the stock 4-player coop check. sv_setmax (default 18) is the real client ceiling and is deliberately NOT set, because 18 already covers 8 humans plus the survivor bots filling the empty slots — raising sv_maxplayers past it advertises slots the engine cannot seat, which surfaces as players failing to connect. See docs/spikes/S2.md, S11-S15. DIRECTOR CVARS ARE ALL FCVAR_CHEAT, and every one of them carries an explicit `rcon` template because of it. The manifest's DEFAULT set path is the Quake-style `<name> "<value>"`, and on these the server answers "Can't use cheat cvar ... unless the server has sv_cheats set to 1" and changes nothing — declaring them without the template would have produced seventeen controls that look fine and do nothing. SourceMod's `sm_cvar` bypasses FCVAR_CHEAT, which is the template used. Measured 2026-08-31: plain `z_hunter_limit 2` refused with the cvar still 1; `sm_cvar z_hunter_limit 2` changed it. TO UNDO A TUNING SESSION, CHANGE THE MAP — measured, a map change restores every one of these to its stock value. `a4d_reset_to_defaults` does NOT: it reports "Restored the default settings" and only resets the cvars All4Dead2 itself changed, leaving z_minion_limit at whatever it was set to. Each entry's `default` here is the server's own ( def. ) value, so a single cvar can also be put back by hand.

commands.name: change_map
commands.description: Load a campaign map (e.g. c1m1_hotel, c2m1_highway).

commands.name: change_mode_and_map
commands.description: Set the game mode and load a map together.

commands.name: kick_userid
commands.description: Kick by numeric userid (from the players query).

commands.name: order_bots
commands.description: Order Left 4 Bots survivors. target: all | #<userid> | <name fragment>. type is one of L4B's twelve: carry follow lead scavenge goto wait deploy tempheal heal use destroy witch. Optional key=value: at=x,y,z (destination), look=x,y,z, ent=N, hold=seconds, pause=0|1. Positions are LITERAL world coordinates - use the ones the inbox captured at the moment the player spoke, not a fresh reading.

commands.name: cancel_bot_orders
commands.description: Drop queued orders. Optional type limits it to one order type.

type.description: an order type, or empty for all

commands.name: give_item
commands.description: Grant a weapon or item (entity name starts with weapon_ or upgrade_). A CHEAT, and off unless the operator set rd_allow_give 1 - the refusal names the switch. This exists because All4Dead2's own spawn commands can never be driven over rcon.

player.description: name fragment, or empty for the first human

commands.name: force_panic
commands.description: Trigger a panic event. Needs a client present (see notes).

commands.name: force_tank
commands.description: Have the director place a Tank. Director-placed and therefore slow to arrive - unlike a spawn, which is instant and local.

commands.name: force_witch
commands.description: Have the director place a Witch. Director-placed and slow, as force_tank.

commands.name: add_zombies
commands.description: Add common infected to the current horde.

commands.name: spawn_infected
commands.description: Spawn a special infected instantly at the caller's position. Instant and local, unlike the force_* commands.

class.description: smoker | boomer | hunter | spitter | jockey | charger | tank | witch

commands.name: panic_forever
commands.description: Panic events without end. Undo with reset_director.

commands.name: continuous_bosses
commands.description: Bosses without end. Undo with reset_director.

commands.name: reset_director
commands.description: One-call undo for everything above, including panic_forever and continuous_bosses. This command is the entire reason this build keeps AtomicStryker's All4Dead2 rather than the more popular fork, which drops it (S11).

queries.name: players
queries.description: Connected players: userid, name, steamid, and the current map.

queries.name: bot_inbox
queries.description: Drain player messages addressed to the bots (chat prefixed with @). Each carries the speaker's eye position and aim point FROZEN at the moment they spoke, which is the whole reason the plugin captures rather than the agent asking later. AT-MOST-ONCE: reading clears the buffer.

queries.name: bot_status
queries.description: Bots, humans, and whether an order can be placed at all. orders_ready reports whether Left4Bots is loaded and running a mode - NOT whether a human is connected, which v3 does not need.

queries.name: bot_orders
queries.description: Each bot's order queue and what it is currently acting on. An order being ACCEPTED and an order being acted on are different facts; this reports the second.

queries.name: scene
queries.description: Tactical readout anchored on the first human: campaign progress, the director's own intensity, every survivor's health and threat state, each special infected with bearing and whether it is closing, and the common horde as a count plus its nearest member. Needs a human connected.

cvars.name: z_difficulty
cvars.description: Difficulty: Easy, Normal, Hard, Impossible.

cvars.name: sv_alltalk
cvars.description: Everyone hears each other's voice.

cvars.name: sv_maxplayers
cvars.description: Max HUMAN players. -1 disables the override and restores the stock 4-player coop check. Bounded at 31 upstream because above that crashes since The Last Stand. Must not exceed sv_setmax.

cvars.name: sv_setmax
cvars.description: Engine max CLIENTS - the real ceiling, and the one people forget. Default 18. Takes effect live over rcon despite upstream documenting only the launch-option form.

cvars.name: sv_visiblemaxplayers
cvars.description: The slot count ADVERTISED to server browsers, and nothing else. It does not change how many can join.

cvars.name: rd_allow_give
cvars.description: Allow the agent to grant weapons and items (a cheat). Off by default: a player can ask and the agent may simply be agreeable, and neither of those is a control.

cvars.name: rd_prefix
cvars.description: Chat prefix marking a message as addressed to the bots. Filtering server-side keeps ordinary table talk out of the agent's context.

cvars.name: z_minion_limit
cvars.description: How many special infected may be ALIVE AT ONCE, all classes combined. This is the ceiling; the per-class limits below divide it up. Stock 3 with every class capped at 1 is why a coop server can never send two hunters — it picks three DIFFERENT specials, always. Raise this and the per-class caps together or nothing changes.

cvars.name: z_hunter_limit
cvars.description: Max hunters alive at once. Stock 1. Counts against z_minion_limit, so raising this alone just makes hunters more likely to be one of the three, not more numerous overall.

cvars.name: z_smoker_limit
cvars.description: Max smokers alive at once. Stock 1. See z_hunter_limit.

cvars.name: z_boomer_limit
cvars.description: Max boomers alive at once. Stock 1. See z_hunter_limit.

cvars.name: z_spitter_limit
cvars.description: Max spitters alive at once. Stock 1. See z_hunter_limit.

cvars.name: z_jockey_limit
cvars.description: Max jockeys alive at once. Stock 1. See z_hunter_limit.

cvars.name: z_charger_limit
cvars.description: Max chargers alive at once. Stock 1. See z_hunter_limit.

cvars.name: z_common_limit
cvars.description: How many common infected may exist at once (the game's own help text). This is the standing horde, not a panic event — raising it makes the map feel busier everywhere, and is the cvar most likely to cost server CPU.

cvars.name: z_mob_spawn_min_size
cvars.description: Smallest horde the director may send in a mob event. Stock 10. The pair with z_mob_spawn_max_size sets how variable a horde feels; narrowing them makes every rush the same size.

cvars.name: z_mob_spawn_max_size
cvars.description: Largest ordinary horde. Stock 30. Must be >= z_mob_spawn_min_size or hordes come out at the minimum.

cvars.name: z_mega_mob_size
cvars.description: Size of the rare 'mega mob' the director reserves for big moments. Stock 50 — already well above z_mob_spawn_max_size, which is what makes it read as an event rather than a horde.

cvars.name: director_relax_min_interval
cvars.description: Shortest time in seconds the director will stay in its RELAX phase between waves. Stock 30. Lowering this and the max is the single most effective way to make a map feel relentless WITHOUT changing how much is spawned at once — it removes the quiet, not the ceiling.

cvars.name: director_relax_max_interval
cvars.description: Longest relax phase in seconds. Stock 45. Must be >= the min.

cvars.name: director_intensity_relax_threshold
cvars.description: All survivors must be below this intensity before a peak is allowed to become a relax (the game's own help text). Stock 0.9. Lowering it makes the director wait for the team to be genuinely calm, so pressure arrives in longer, harder blocks; raising it toward 1.0 lets waves follow each other more quickly.

cvars.name: z_safe_spawn_range
cvars.description: Minimum range for spawning special zombies (the game's own help text). Stock 250. Lowering it lets specials appear closer to the team, which reads as unfair rather than hard — the usual reason a server feels cheap.

cvars.name: z_tank_health
cvars.description: Tank max health (the game's own help text). Stock 4000 on Normal. Difficulty already scales this, so change it only when you want a tank that differs from the difficulty you have chosen.

cvars.name: z_witch_health
cvars.description: Witch max health (the game's own help text). Stock 1000.
